title: Pop-Up Bookshop | Dreamfarmcommons
plain_text:
Fading Gesture
Pop-Up Photography Book Shop
September 20 – 26, 2018
Opening Friday September 21, 6PM - 9PM
3SSSTUDIOS.COM at Dream Farm Commons
Open Thursday Friday Tuesday Wednesday Saturday
September 20, 21, 25, 26, 27, 1:30 pm - 6:30pmFor one week only, we are presenting an extraordinary collection of images and photography books curated by 3SSSTUDIOS.COM at Dream Farm Commons. This is a collection of infrequently found art books from international and local publishers in China, Italy, Britain, and the Bay Area framed by new works of
Shisi Huang, Yong Xiao, Nanxi Zhou. The works are gathered under a wide but very specific umbrella of twists of truth and representation: the verifiable occurrence made strange, the supernatural as captured or fabricated, decontextualized imagery, questionable documentation, broken frames, the fantastic and the ordinary juxtaposed. The fine art books are presented with new works by three emerging artists whose own work engages with tenderly unstable truth. Please come by to the opening this Friday September 21, 6-9PM. We will also be open Thursday Friday Tuesday Wednesday Saturday from 1:30-6:30PM (September 20, 21 25, 26, 27 )
